اعتدلت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَلْتُ (iʕtadaltu) /iʕ.ta.dal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# اِعْتَدَلْتَ (iʕtadalta) /iʕ.ta.dal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# اِعْتَدَلْتِ (iʕtadalti) /iʕ.ta.dal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# اِعْتَدَلَتْ (iʕtadalat) /iʕ.ta.da.lat/: third-perso
